index.description: The document's place in the file, from 0.

name.description: A routine's name: 1 to 40 characters once trimmed, no control or format (zero-width) characters, so it is also a valid tag; stored trimmed, unique per environment ignoring case.

oneOf.description: Never due: the routine runs when run now.

minute.description: The minute past each hour it is due, 0 to 59.

oneOf.description: Due every hour at a minute past it.

at.description: When in the day it is due, HH:MM in the routine's zone.

oneOf.description: Due every day at a time.

at.description: When in the day it is due, HH:MM in the routine's zone.

oneOf.description: Due Monday to Friday at a time.

day.description: A day of the week, named in English and lower case: monday to sunday.

at.description: When in the day it is due, HH:MM in the routine's zone.

oneOf.description: Due one day a week at a time.

items.description: A day of the week, named in English and lower case: monday to sunday.

days.description: The days it is due, each once.

at.description: When in the day it is due, HH:MM in the routine's zone.

oneOf.description: Due on some days of the week at a time.

day.description: The day of the month, 1 to 31; a month without it is skipped.

at.description: When in the day it is due, HH:MM in the routine's zone.

oneOf.description: Due one day a month at a time; a month without the day is skipped, as cron does.

expression.description: Five fields (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week) with *, lists, ranges, steps and month and day names; no seconds field and no @ form (cases/schedule-validation.json).

oneOf.description: Due when a five-field cron expression matches; both day fields restricted, neither beginning with *, combine with OR, as Vixie cron's do.

schedule.description: When a routine is due, in its zone at minute resolution: manual (run now only), hourly at a minute, daily, weekdays, weekly on a day, on some days, monthly on a day, or a cron expression. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule schedule and its reason, when the schedule maths refuses it (cases/schedule-validation.json): a cron expression it cannot read or that is never due, or due times that can fall under five minutes apart.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone's name, such as Europe/London or UTC; one a client writes must be a zone the environment's zone data knows (WrittenTimeZone).

ifMissed.description: What a routine does with due times its environment missed: run-once (the latest fires once when the environment is back, within seven days) or skip (each is skipped missed).

instructions.description: What a firing's run is asked to do: 1 to 100,000 characters, after the header the environment writes.

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine: an absolute path, or one starting ~ for the environment's home.

oneOf.description: A directory the environment has: recorded at its absolute path, ~ expanded to the environment's home, . and .. resolved as written and symlinks kept; refused workspace_unusable, with its problem, when the environment cannot use it.

repository.description: Any path inside the repository; the worktree is made from its main checkout.

branch.description: An existing local branch to check out in the worktree.

name.description: The new branch's name; agent-harness/ and the session id's first eight characters when absent.

base.description: The ref the branch starts from, any ref; the main checkout's HEAD when absent.

newBranch.description: A branch the worktree is made on, made with it.

oneOf.description: A worktree the environment makes from a repository it has: from its main checkout (or bare repository), under the environment's worktrees root, locked for the session, with the ignored files the checkout's .worktreeinclude names copied in; on an existing branch, or on a new one (the new branch with its presets when neither is named), nothing fetched. Refused with the reason git's answer gives: not_a_repository, git_unavailable, no_commits, git_filters_refused, branch_exists, branch_not_found, branch_checked_out or git_failed.
A scratch directory of the session's own.

anyOf.description: A repository identity: the one form every spelling of a repository's remote comes down to, https:// then the host without its port and the path of two segments or more, in lower case (repositoryIdentityOf and cases/repository-identity.json). An identity, not a link.

repositoryIdentity.description: The repository identity the workspace resolved to when the routine was saved, which a move re-resolves it by; null outside a repository, for scratch, or before the environment has resolved it.

workspace.description: Where a routine's firings run: a directory, a worktree made per firing, or a scratch directory made per firing, never another session's; with the repository identity it resolved to when saved.

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

email.description: The login's email, as the provider's status reports it.

organisation.description: The organisation the login belongs to, when the provider reports one.

anyOf.description: Who an account signed in as: the provider, the email and the organisation when present; one account per identity per environment.

account.description: The account a firing runs on, by identity; null for the environment's default account at each firing.

model.description: The model a firing's runs use; null for the strongest of accounts.defaultModelFamily.

effort.description: The reasoning effort a firing's runs take; null for accounts.defaultEffort.

anyOf.description: What an agent may do without asking during a run, in the order ceilings use: plan < acceptEdits < auto < bypassPermissions. Claude's default and dontAsk are never used.

mode.description: The mode a firing's runs ask for, clamped to the ceiling it was saved under; null for permissions.unattended.mode.

anyOf.description: Where a run may reach: off (nothing applied), workspace (writes only inside the workspace), workspace-no-network (and no network for the model's commands and fetches).

containment.description: The containment level of a firing's session; null for permissions.containment.default.

injection.description: Whether a firing's runs and pre-check get the environment's credential injection, the forge variables and the credential helper among it: inherit (as the environment's setting says), allow or deny.

items.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

skills.description: Names from the skill set, each once, loaded always-on for a firing's runs.

path.description: A script's path relative to the environment's scripts directory; it must stay inside that directory once links are followed, which the environment checks at each firing.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the script may run before its process tree is killed, 1 to 600 seconds.

oneOf.description: A script in the environment's scripts directory, run with no arguments; its standard output is the pre-check's output.

url.description: The URL fetched with a GET; its body is the pre-check's output.

oneOf.description: A URL fetched with a GET, up to five redirects; a status other than 2xx is a failure.

anyOf.description: What a routine runs before each firing, whose unchanged output skips the model: a script in the scripts directory, or a URL.

preCheck.description: What runs before each firing; null for none, so every due time fires.

silenceMarker.description: The final text that delivers nothing: 1 to 64 characters.

maxDurationMinutes.description: How long a firing may run before its live run is interrupted: 1 to 1,440 minutes.

on.description: Which results a delivery target takes: success (a succeeded firing), failure (a failed firing or a failing skip), or both.

oneOf.description: routine.delivered on the environment stream, which every connected client raises.

target.description: The endpoint's name on the routine's environment, which holds its URL and secret.

on.description: Which results a delivery target takes: success (a succeeded firing), failure (a failed firing or a failing skip), or both.

oneOf.description: A signed webhook POST to an endpoint the environment names.

items.description: Where a firing's result goes, and which results it takes: a client notice, or a signed webhook to a named endpoint.

delivery.description: Where a firing's result goes: up to 8 targets.

enabled.description: Whether the scheduler fires it; run now works either way.

anyOf.description: A routine's definition as saved: its name, schedule and zone, what it does with missed due times, its instructions, workspace, account, model, effort, mode, containment, credential injection, skills, pre-check, silence marker, maximum duration, delivery targets and whether it is enabled.

definition.description: The definition as it would be saved, its workspace placed on this environment; null when the document does not read as a routine. A name another routine holds is an issue beside it.

items.description: One schema issue: a code, the path to the offending value and a message.

issues.description: What is wrong in the document, each at its path; empty when nothing is.

items.description: What needs attention on a routine: account_missing (no account here has its identity, or none is the default), account_signed_out, model_unavailable (the account does not offer its model), skill_unknown (a name in its skills is not in the skill set of the account it resolves to; unknownSkills names each), script_missing (its pre-check's script is not in the scripts directory), endpoint_missing (a webhook target names no endpoint here), endpoint_needs_secret (a target's endpoint has no secret), clamped (its effective mode is below the mode it asks for), failing (its failure streak is not zero) or delivery_failing (the last delivery to a target failed finally).

attention.description: What the routine would need attention for here: an account, model, skill, script or endpoint this environment lacks.

items.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

unknownSkills.description: The names in its skills that the skill set of the account it would resolve to here does not hold, in their order: what skill_unknown names.

oneOf.description: A directory the environment has: recorded at its absolute path, ~ expanded to the environment's home, . and .. resolved as written and symlinks kept; refused workspace_unusable, with its problem, when the environment cannot use it.

base.description: The ref the branch starts from, any ref; the main checkout's HEAD when absent.

Refused with the reason git's answer gives: not_a_repository, git_unavailable, no_commits, git_filters_refused, branch_exists, branch_not_found, branch_checked_out or git_failed.

repositoryIdentity.description: The repository identity the workspace resolved to when the routine was saved, which a move re-resolves it by; null outside a repository, for scratch, or before the environment has resolved it.

anyOf.description: Where a routine's firings run: a directory, a worktree made per firing, or a scratch directory made per firing, never another session's; with the repository identity it resolved to when saved.

workspace.description: The workspace as re-resolved here, when the document's path is not usable on this environment: the most recently used checkout with its repository identity, else scratch; null when it is used as written.

warnings.description: What importing a routine document would leave a person to know: the attention it would show here, and its workspace as re-resolved.

items.description: One routine document as an import would read it: the definition as it would be saved, the issues with their paths, and the warnings.

documents.description: Each document, in the file's order.
